assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis is paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes and guide further management.
The CPT code for the mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is 93229.
The payer's letter states that coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The service was rendered on the episode dated 48 days ago.
The appeal is filed within the 132-day deadline.
The payer retro-auth window is 30 days.
The service was rendered under payer meridian.
